content:
id: terminal_control_voice
description: Sleep, volume, identity, and self-care are handled locally — acknowledge only.
capabilities: Avoid inventing device-control tool calls for sleep/volume/health/restart.
good_for: sleep, mute, volume, health, restart, heal, who am i
planner_hint: Attach for COMSTAR voice agents that may hear device commands.
user_goal_keywords:
  - sleep
  - volume
  - mute
  - health
  - restart
  - heal
  - who am i
  - recognize me

content:
  body: |
    Device control note:
    - Sleep, speaker volume, who-am-I / recognize-me, health status,
      restart bridge/audio/kiosk, full reboot, and heal-yourself are handled
      by the terminal outside this agent.
    - If asked about those, give a short acknowledgment only.
    - Heal reports what was wrong and what was fixed after the check finishes.

inject:
  target: backstory
  heading: "## Terminal control (voice)"
  max_chars: 1200
